name: What is the typical cost of installing a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of installing a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a walk-in shower varies widely based on materials, size, features, and labor. A basic installation might start around $5,000, while more luxurious designs with custom tiling, high-end fixtures, and extensive waterproofing could exceed $15,000. Key cost drivers include tile selection, type of shower pan, glass enclosure design (frameless is usually more expensive), plumbing modifications, and any necessary structural changes. Obtaining a detailed quote is essential for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs range from approximately $5,000 to over $15,000, influenced by materials, size, features, and labor.
